story: The opening 90 minutes saw numerous attacks, with Soudal Quick-Step repeatedly neutralising moves involving too many riders or strong contenders. Eventually, a four-rider breakaway established a gap, allowing the pace in the peloton to ease. Later in the stage, Narváez attacked on a climb and bridged across to the leaders. The breakaway was subsequently caught on the upper slopes, after which Soudal Quick-Step worked to ensure a bunch sprint. Narváez claimed the bonus sprint. In the final sprint, Frits Biesterbos took an impressive victory through excellent positioning and a powerful acceleration, beating Magnier and Kooij.
